thesis: Strategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR; formerly MicroStrategy) is a public bitcoin treasury vehicle wrapped around a legacy enterprise analytics software franchise. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$463.5 million**, mostly subscription and support for Strategy One / cloud analytics. **[Fact]** The balance sheet is dominated by bitcoin: **672,500 BTC** at fair value **$58.9 billion** at December 31, 2025, rising to **762,099 BTC** (**$64.0 billion** fair value) at March 31, 2026 per the Q1 10-Q. **[Fact]** The company funds purchases with convertible notes, preferred stock (STRK, STRF, STRD, STRC), and common equity ATM programs; long-term debt was **~$8.2 billion** and temporary equity (preferred) **~$9.0 billion** at Q1 2026. Operating cash flow from software was **$67.2 million** in FY2025 while GAAP net income swung on **$5.4 billion** of unrealized BTC marks.
why_market_wrong: The market prices MSTR as a levered call on bitcoin with an embedded software annuity, not as a normalized software compounder. **[Inference]** At roughly **$390** per share (placeholder until market refresh), the stock embeds a large premium to filing look-through net asset value (~**$110** per share of GAAP equity at Q1 2026, or ~**$150** per share on a simplified BTC-minus-debt bridge). Mispricing debates are about **mNAV premium persistence**, dilution from the capital-markets flywheel, and whether spot bitcoin ETFs arbitrage away the equity wrapper. There is no dated equity yield curve; the predictive attribute is **levered digital-asset accumulation** rather than a passive royalty trust.
